And note that, under this license, the album is NOT "free as in beer". There is a Non-Commercial release on Jamendo, though.

Jamendo will take music uploaded with free culture licensing and include boilerplate that says you need a license for commercial use. I bet some people like to pay for the license so they have a receipt.
If you buy it from Bandcamp, it's CC BY-SA. On Jamendo, it's CC BY-NC-SA, and that seems to be by artist intent.

The CC BY-SA license overrules the NC in the other license. If a work is released under multiple licenses the reuser gets to choose which license to use. In practice the two licenses are nearly identical since a big commercial project will not use an SA clause and NC is very ambiguous.
